definition_used: A change in the copyright and/or ownership of the article or any of its content.
caution: The definition describes a legal status change, not a direct integrity problem with research content, authorship, peer review, or post-publication oversight. It does not map to any of the four manuscript-facing categories.
semantic_rationale: The reason concerns a change in copyright/ownership, which is a legal rights matter. It does not inherently indicate issues with research reliability, attribution integrity, editorial governance, or post-publication transparency processes as defined.
